prompt:
Use case: style-transfer
Asset type: Daythread application icon refinement.
Input image: EDIT TARGET — the original pocket-memory recorder concept. The user prefers this first design and wants only a SLIGHT adjustment to make it more app-icon-like. Preserve its identity rather than redesigning it.
Keep the recognizable rounded dark pebble shape, warm copper edge and wrapping thread, ivory voice waveform, small amber status light, rich midnight palette, attractive depth, and overall composition. Retain enough dimensional detail and visual richness; do NOT turn it into a flat logo or a simple set of shapes.
Make these restrained refinements: smooth away all photographic surface grain; simplify the braided cord to one smooth illustrated copper band; simplify the dangling tag into a short clean integrated bookmark tab; make the device a little more front-facing with less visible sidewall; simplify highlights into broad crisp illustrated light planes rather than realistic reflections. Give the symbol deliberate, polished 2.5D app-icon geometry, with carefully rounded clean contours and controlled depth. Reduce tiny details, not the concept.
Remove the floor, photographic backdrop and cast ground shadow. Use a uniform full-bleed deep midnight-petrol square behind the central symbol. The object should feel like an illustrated emblem on an app tile, not a photograph sitting on a surface. Center it with roughly 15 percent safe margins. No outside rounded-square border or rounded outer corners; the OS applies its own mask. No letters, words, numbers, extra objects, glow or sparkles. Produce ONE refined finished square icon. Priority: stay recognizably close to the original, just more deliberately illustrated and icon-like.
